objectives.text: Add discount‑code handling to the Cart class.
Expose a new method Cart.apply_discount(code) that validates and stores a discount.
Expose a new method Cart.total() that returns the subtotal after applying the stored discount (or the raw subtotal when no discount is stored).
Preserve all existing Cart behaviour (add, subtotal, error handling).

acceptance_criteria.text: Cart.apply_discount('SAVE10') stores a 10 % discount and Cart.total() returns the subtotal reduced by 10 %, rounded to two decimal places. Example: for a cart with subtotal = 100.00, total() must return 90.00.
Cart.apply_discount('FLAT5') stores a flat‑$5 discount and Cart.total() returns max(subtotal − 5.00, 0), rounded to two decimal places. Example: for a subtotal of 3.00, total() must return 0.00.
Calling Cart.apply_discount with any code other than 'SAVE10' or 'FLAT5' raises a ValueError.
If no discount has been applied, Cart.total() returns the same value as Cart.subtotal().
All existing tests for Cart (subtotal calculation, add validation, etc.) continue to pass unchanged.

tasks.title: Implement discount code support in Cart
tasks.description: Add internal storage for a discount, implement `Cart.apply_discount(code)` that validates the code ('SAVE10' or 'FLAT5') and records the appropriate discount (10 % or $5). Implement `Cart.total()` that returns the subtotal after applying the stored discount (or the raw subtotal when no discount is stored), rounding to two decimal places and never returning a negative value.

tasks.title: Add unit tests for discount functionality
tasks.description: Create new tests in `tests/` covering: (a) applying 'SAVE10' and checking `total()` is 10 % off, (b) applying 'FLAT5' and checking `total()` respects the floor at zero, (c) applying an invalid code raises `ValueError`, (d) calling `total()` with no discount returns the same as `subtotal()`. Ensure tests use the existing Cart API and follow project conventions.

tasks.title: Security review of discount handling
tasks.description: Check that `apply_discount` does not allow injection or unexpected side‑effects. Ensure only the two allowed codes are accepted and that the discount logic cannot be bypassed or cause overflow/underflow issues.

tasks.title: Verify full test suite
tasks.description: Run the complete test suite, including existing Cart tests and the new discount tests. Confirm that all tests pass and that the new functionality meets the acceptance criteria. Capture evidence IDs from the test run.
